fear.text: Creepers avoid cats and ocelots. Keep one nearby to help keep creepers away, but give an approaching creeper plenty of space.

danger.text: Creepers swell and explode near a target. Back away rather than relying on a robot to stop the explosion.

breed.text: Feed wheat to two adult cows that can enter breeding mode. They need to be close enough to breed.

acquisition.text: Look for slimes in swamps or mangrove swamps between Y=51 and Y=69 in dim light. Full moons are better; swamp slimes do not spawn on a new moon. Slimes also spawn below Y=40 in special slime chunks, regardless of light. In Bedrock, slime-chunk positions are the same across world seeds. They still need suitable spawning space.
